intro: Backend engineering for teams and businesses that need reliable systems. Available for B2B contracts, permanent roles and private commissions.

cards.title: Backend and microservices

cards.title: Payment and financial integrations

cards.title: API design and integration support

cards.title: Production support and reliability

cards.title: Websites and web applications

cards.title: CI/CD pipelines
